verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Pydantic AI supports token streaming across many providers (pydantic-ai-comm-3), but hands-on production use reports that streaming structured events (tool calls, steps) to a UI still requires 'a lot of glue' — reconnection, structured event wiring, history across turns (pydantic-ai-comm-17) — indicating this isn't a turnkey capability. No first-party docs in the pack explicitly describe streaming intermediate tool-call/step events to a UI. Missing for 10: documented API/example for streaming tool-call and step events specifically (not just token streams), and independent confirmation that UI wiring is not extra 'glue' work.
